[[File:Stat Spy icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Stat Spy''' is a [[Lunar spells|lunar spell]] which requires the completion of [[Lunar Diplomacy]] and [[Dream Mentor]] to cast. The spell may be cast at level 75 [[Magic]] and requires two [[Astral rune|astral]], two [[Cosmic rune|cosmic]], and five [[body rune]]s. The spell may be cast on other players to discover stats, including current [[Hitpoints]], all skills, and boosted stats.

The target of the spell receives a message that their stats are being spied upon along with the name of the caster.

[[File:Stat Spy view.png|thumb|left|The interface Stat Spy opens.]]
